title: Time out a stalled public submission
why_it_matters: A fetch that never settles keeps the form submitting and its button disabled. Reloading discards the in-memory request ID, so retrying can duplicate a submission that committed without returning a response.
validation_reason: At 44eca17, createPublicClient awaits fetch without a signal or deadline (research-intake-ui.js:25), while the shared button helper disables its button until the async submit handler settles (research-client.js button); a fetch that never settles therefore leaves submission pending and blocks a same-page retry, and reloading loses the in-memory pending requestId, though network-stall incidence was not measured.

title: Preserve current edits and acknowledgement during terms refresh
